description: Expose a query surface on inventory-app that routines-app can hit to determine whether a given routine's required products / tools are available. Minimum: GET /items?query=<semantic> or GET /items/check?names=x,y,z returning per-item availability. Routines-app surfaces routines as blocked on missing inventory when the check fails. This is the inventory-maturity signal the monetization revenue-line gates depend on.
name: inventory-app-read-api-for-routines
title: Inventory Read-API For Routines-App Gating
